request: Regenerate complete AC1012 DWG samples according to the versioned dictionary and MLINESTYLE specification after the current implementation commit; keep all generated files outside the repository.

authority.document: ODA Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
sections: §9 HEADER VARIABLES: DIMSTYLE is an H hard pointer
authority.appliedLayout: The AC1012 DICTIONARY frame has counted entry-name streams, soft-owner item handles, and no R2000+ cloning or hard-owner fields. ACAD_MLINESTYLE is rooted in NOD; each selected MLINESTYLE is owned by that dictionary; HEADER DIMSTYLE resolves to Standard.

producer.toolchain: GNU LibreDWG 0.14 dwgadd/dwgread/dwgwrite; a specification-directed JSON rewrite binds HEADER DIMSTYLE to Standard

physicalFrameTest.result: PASS for both exact physical DICTIONARY frames, including role/truncation refusal and corrected retry

strict.reason: AC1012 ACAD_MLINESTYLE dictionary duplicate-merge semantics lack native qualification

currentCandidate.sourceRead: Each sample parses with all 31 observed frames published and no failed, deferred, quarantined or unresolved frames.

fixturePolicy: The two complete DWGs and all emitted DXFs remain scratch-only; no fixture is added to Git.
limits: The newly generated pair repeats the existing same-key 15/37-degree discriminator; it is a current-candidate recheck, not a new native-semantic discriminator.
LibreDWG is the sample producer and a peer parser, not an AutoCAD witness.
AutoCAD normal-open and duplicate-key import/clone behavior remain unknown; strict output remains guarded. No support claim is promoted.
